user.title: Adaptative Climate
user.description: A climate entity that drives one or more climate entities, one per mode.

modes.name: Modes

readings.description: Reference sensor, offsets and external sensors of the sources, phase hysteresis.

fan_swing.description: Modes that share their fan and swing values.
